name: gap-web-search-brave
about: tools.webSearch provider=brave（webSearch.ts:390-471）：GET + X-Subscription-Token，查询参数 q/count/country（endpoint 自带的参数保留）；web.results 解析。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
tools:
  webSearch:
    enabled: true
    provider: brave
    endpoint: {MOCK}/brave?fixed=1
    apiKey: key-brave
